For a first-timer like me, what's the safest, easiest choice?
The absolute safest and easiest choice for a beginner is the Snake Plant.
It is practically indestructible because it tolerates almost any lighting condition—from bright, indirect light to low-light corners—and handles neglect very well. You only need to water it once the soil has dried out completely (about every few weeks).
Options like the Snake Plant, Zeylanica 6" or Snake Plant, Moonshine 4" are fantastic starter options to build your confidence!
